features: Face detection: Up to 10 human faces can be captured simultaneously and supports detecting, capturing, gradind, selecting of face in motion and output tbe best face image
Face recognition: Detects and recognizes faces by comparing them to stored portrait images. Actions can be triggered via the allowed, blocked and other list
Object classification: Detects people, non-motorized vehicles and/or vehicles in full screen or a defined image section
Intrusion detection: Enter and loiter in a pre-defined virtual region
License plate recognition: Detects and recognizes car number plates. Data- import- export function, actions can be triggered via the allowed, blocked and other list
Object counting: Entrance and Exit object number is accounted and showed on screen in real time
Line crossing: Cross a pre-defined virtual line
People & vehicle detection: Adjustable whether people, motorized or non-motorized vehicles should be detected.
Region entrance: Enter a pre-defined virtual region from the outside place
Region exiting: Exit from a pre-defined virtual region
Object removal: Detects within a predefined, adjustable area objects that were originally placed in a specific location and have been removed, as well as objects that have been left behind there
Heat map: Visualizes the number of people in the surveillance area over a period of time with a simple and user-friendly color scheme
Audio detection: Sudden audio increase, decrease
Tamper protection: Detection of scene change, defocus, sudden audio increase/decrease or audio loss.
Frame rate (R): 2-ch @ 32 MP (30 fps) + 2-ch @ 8 MP (30 fps), 10-ch @ 8 MP (30 fps) , 20-ch @ 4MP (30 fps) , 40-ch @ 1080p (30 fps)
Video compression: H.264, H.264+, H.265, H.265+
